info.description:
Full API collection for the Sentrifugo Timesheet Management Service (TSM).

Set the `base_url` and `auth_token` collection variables before use.

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Acme Corporation",
    "industry": "Technology",
    "contact_person": "John Doe",
    "contact_email": "john@acme.com",
    "contact_phone": "+1-555-0100",
    "address": "123 Tech Street, San Francisco, CA",
    "portal_access_enabled": true,
    "notes": "Key client for Q3 projects"
}

{
    "client_id": "{{client_id}}",
    "name": "Website Redesign",
    "code": "WR-2026",
    "description": "Complete website overhaul for Acme Corp",
    "project_type": "time_and_materials",
    "start_date": "2026-01-01",
    "end_date": "2026-06-30",
    "budget_hours": 500,
    "hourly_rate": 150.00,
    "currency": "USD"
}

{
    "daily_time_entry_enabled": false,
    "allow_past_due_submission": true,
    "limit_older_than_weeks_enabled": false,
    "limit_older_than_weeks": 4,
    "limit_timesheets_to_enabled": false,
    "limit_timesheets_to_value": 2,
    "limit_timesheets_to_unit": "days",
    "restrict_time_off_entries": false,
    "allow_attachment": true,
    "submission_compliance_type": "weekly",
    "submission_deadline_hours": 15,
    "submission_day": "friday",
    "submission_time": "18:00",
    "auto_submit_enabled": false
}

request.description: Trigger auto-submission of all past-deadline DRAFT timesheets for organisations with auto_submit_enabled=true. Requires X-Internal-Key header matching INTERNAL_API_KEY env var.
